fact: NTRA chief executive Mohamed Shamrokh says a unified national 'digital identity' project, led by the communications ministry, is being built to give one comprehensive digital identity for the whole state, on infrastructure set up with the Interior Ministry, with full operation still to come.
The National ID System runs a card production center and issuing centers, with citizens' images and fingerprints held in the databases.
The Public Prosecution says its online service verifies the enquirer through the digital identity system, on records keyed to the national number.
Egypt's Ministry of Interior says its Civil Status Sector caravans in ten governorates issued 6,320 national ID cards, with further cards issued through hotlines and home visits.
